name: GPU-16
description: A CPU with a small 3D graphics pipeline. The CPU turns and projects points with a multiply-accumulate unit, writes triangles into a list on their own bus, and starts the rasterizer, which reads them by itself and fills them on the video bus with shaded colours and a depth buffer, one transfer per tick, while the CPU carries on.
